## Signal Ingestion Poller

**Objective:** Periodically fetch real hiring signals from a live public job API and push them to the backend ingest webhook.

**Owner:** Team 2 - Hiring Intelligence

**Job source (current):** Remotive public API (https://remotive.com/api/remote-jobs) - chosen because it requires no API key/signup, is publicly documented, and is ToS-compliant (SRS section 3.3 - no login-gated scraping).

**Swapping sources later:** Once official access to LinkedIn Jobs API / Indeed Publisher API (SRS section 4) is set up, only the "Fetch Real-Time Jobs" node's URL/auth needs to change - everything downstream (normalize, dedupe, POST) stays the same.

**Backend endpoint:** POST /api/webhooks/signal-ingest
(placeholder: http://localhost:3000 - swap for real backend URL via the `BACKEND_BASE_URL` env var once backend is deployed)

**Dedupe:** dedupe_key = hash(company_name + role_title + source_url). Company *domain* isn't known yet at this stage (that's the Enrichment Agent's job downstream per SRS section 8), so we key on company name instead of domain here.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (Every 15 min)
nodes.notes: Polling interval should eventually be made configurable per source (see SRS Workflow 1). 15 min is the default for now.

nodes.name: Fetch Real-Time Jobs
nodes.notes: No auth required for Remotive's public endpoint. `category` narrows results to software/dev roles - remove or change this param to widen/narrow the search. Swap this node's URL for LinkedIn Jobs API / Indeed Publisher API once official credentials are available.

nodes.name: POST to Signal Ingest Webhook
nodes.notes: Replace placeholder URL with the real backend once deployed, via BACKEND_BASE_URL environment variable. Auth header (HMAC signature per SRS section 14/18) should be added here once the backend's service-auth scheme is finalized. Runs once per normalized job item (up to MAX_JOBS_PER_POLL requests per execution).
